The unsettling revelations, encompassing the period from 2009 to 2011, underscore a deplorable culture of abuse in the correctional facility.

article_content: In an interview soon after his hospital release in Sao Paulo, Brazil, soccer legend Pele joked about his legendary tri-cardiac identity. 'I had my worries, yet not a fear of dying burgeoned within me. I'm heartily proud of hailing from Tres Coracoes,' he quipped. Also, the past of being operated on was candidly shared -- a narrative he felt might surprise many fans. Soccer icon, affectionately dubbed 'The King, ' Pele remains an advocate for football and the destitute, while privately cherishing his Santos jersey.
